facts.headline: Canada Tar Sands Shutdown Marks Turning Point in Resource Collapse
facts.summary: Canada's Horizon tar sands project shut down today—not because of policy or protest, but because the Athabasca River can no longer support it. This marks a new phase in collapse: the land itself is setting limits. The Canada tar sands shutdown shows extractive industry is now failing on ecological, not economic, terms.
